name: Sunitinib (GIST, second-line)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.KIT: acquired imatinib resistance is usually driven by secondary KIT (or PDGFRA) mutations; sunitinib has activity against KIT exon 9 and some ATP-binding-pocket secondary mutations
biomarkers.note: Sunitinib is the standard second-line TKI for advanced GIST after failure of or intolerance to imatinib (category 1). It also has activity in SDH-deficient GIST. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors, GIST-D, and DeVita 12th ed. (lines 118425 to 118432).

supportiveCare: 50 mg daily 4-weeks-on / 2-weeks-off (6-week cycle) or continuous 37.5 mg daily; continue until progression or intolerance.
Monitor blood pressure for TKI-associated hypertension; assess hand-foot skin reaction each cycle.
Antiemetic/G-CSF prophylaxis not routinely required for oral sunitinib monotherapy.
monitoring: blood pressure (TKI-associated hypertension) at baseline and each cycle
hand-foot skin reaction assessment each cycle
left ventricular function / cardiac assessment as indicated

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3-4 hypertension or hand-foot skin reaction
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and resume at a reduced dose (e.g., 37.5 mg) per labeling; manage blood pressure; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Sunitinib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. (lines 118431 to 118432). Sunitinib 50 mg PO once daily for 4 weeks (days 1 to 28) followed by a 2-week rest, in a 6-week (42-day) cycle - this is the schedule the pivotal GIST trial evaluated. ALTERNATIVE source-stated schedule: continuous daily sunitinib 37.5 mg with no planned break (DeVita line 118432; Standard Guidelines (NCCN) GIST v1.2026 gist lines 1535, 1539). Days array encodes the 28 on-treatment days of the 42-day cycle. No ISMP tall-man form. Sunitinib-specific monitoring: hypertension (blood pressure at baseline and each cycle), hand-foot skin reaction, fatigue, thyroid function, and cardiac function.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: lines 118431 to 118432 (sunitinib 50 mg daily for 4 weeks with a 2-week rest; a continuous regimen with a daily dose of 37.5 mg can be used as well)
